q: What are the CO2 emissions of singeing fabric per metre?
title: Fabric singeing CO2 per metre
short: Singeing burns off surface fibres with gas flames, so the gas burned is Scope 1. Divide the singeing machine's gas use by metres processed, then multiply by the factor: 2.98 kg CO2 per kg of LPG, or the IPCC natural gas default for PNG. Add the machine's electricity.

ul: Gas meter or LPG cylinder log for the machine.
Metres singed, from the production register.

p: Burner tuning and switching off flames during stops lower gas per metre.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
